title: Simon & Garfunkel – Bridge Over Troubled Water (8-Track Tape, VTG, A&M Records)
descriptionText:
Format: 8-Track Stereo Tape Cartridge
Artist: Simon & Garfunkel
Album: Bridge Over Troubled Water
Label: A&M Records / Columbia TC8 (Catalog 18 10 0750)
Country: USA
Genre: Folk Rock, Pop Rock
Era: 1970
Track Listing (Programs):
Bridge Over Troubled Water • Why Don’t You Write Me • Song for the Asking
The Boxer • The Only Living Boy in New York
El Condor Pasa • Cecilia • Baby Driver
Keep the Customer Satisfied • So Long, Frank Lloyd Wright • Bye Bye Love
Condition:
Tape Cartridge: Red Columbia TC8 shell, intact but with noticeable wear and scuffing. Labels show age and discoloration.
Slipcase: Original A&M slipcase included. Moderate to heavy wear with edge damage, scuffs, and a tear/hole through the front artwork.
Labels: Clear and legible, though aged.
Untested: This tape has not been play-tested. Sold as a collectible only.
See all photos for exact condition.
Notes:
Iconic 1970 release featuring classic songs like Bridge Over Troubled Water, The Boxer, and Cecilia.
Vintage 8-track format collectible — great for display or to complete a Simon & Garfunkel collection.
Early Columbia TC8 audiopak cartridge edition.
